[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lavender bitters can add a fascinating dimension to cocktails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pairing lavender bitters with citrus flavors is a great idea.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe suggestion: **Lavender Gin Fizz** - 2 oz gin, 1 oz freshly squeezed lemon juice, 1/2 oz simple syrup, 2 dashes lavender bitters, club soda, garnish with a lemon wheel and a sprig of lavender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe suggestion: **Lavender Sunset** - 2 oz tequila, 1 oz freshly squeezed grapefruit juice, 1/2 oz honey syrup, 2 dashes lavender bitters, ice, garnish with a slice of grapefruit and a sprig of rosemary.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe suggestion: **Lavender Collins** - 2 oz gin, 1 oz freshly squeezed lime juice, 1/2 oz simple syrup, 2 dashes lavender bitters, club soda, garnish with a lime wheel and a sprig of lavender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe suggestion: **Lavender Sidecar** - 2 oz Cognac, 3/4 oz freshly squeezed lemon juice, 1/2 oz simple syrup, 2 dashes lavender bitters, garnish with a lemon wheel and a sprig of lavender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe suggestion: **Lavender Spritz** - 2 oz Prosecco, 1 oz Aperol, 1 oz lemon-lime soda, 2 dashes lavender bitters, slice of orange for garnish, sprig of lavender for garnish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Start with a small amount of lavender bitters (2-3 dashes) and adjust to taste.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for using lavender in sweet dishes:
